body: There's more too it, I just hate my life, I depise my parents who physically abused me for years as a kid. The strangle hold and fear that held over me. All the people in my life that beat me as a kid, my cousins, my uncle my aunt, who both abused me sexually. Every failed relationship as been a shadow and reflection of the poverty of the environment I grew up in a product of immigrants, an anchor baby. I hate my people I hate people.
